title: Multi-regional graceful-degradation SLI explorer and circuit orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: customer-facing applications see occasional token-level p99/p999 latency spikes in a single region that lead to global degradation because fanout paths cause downstream queues to back up. Current dashboards show per-route percentiles but do not expose a region-scoped degradation score or the ability to test adaptive circuit changes without a production incident.

Goal: build an interactive SLI explorer and orchestration layer that surfaces 'regional graceful-degradation' signals (combined token-latency SLI, queue-admit-rate, and KV cache hit adjustment) and enables safe circuit threshold experiments and controlled rollouts. This ticket covers instrument design, dashboard buildout, a small controller prototype to drive circuit threshold changes (read-only feature-flag gated), and rollout/runbook updates.

Non-goals: implementing full auto-heal or closed-loop throttling; full rollout of automated circuit toggles across Dedicated customers (this will be a controlled internal canary).
acceptance_criteria: Explorer UI shows per-region degradation score (0-100) derived from token-p99, admit-rate, and recent KV hit rate for selected routes
Dashboard can filter by model, route, and sequence-length bucket and show historical correlation between region score and failover events
Controller prototype exposes an API to propose circuit threshold adjustments, with two-phase commit and dry-run mode
A playbook (runbook) documents how to use the explorer to make manual adjustments and rollback steps; runbook reviewed by SRE and PM
Telemetry emitted for every proposal and applied threshold change (who/why/which-region), with links to GitHub PRs and dashboard snapshots
tasks: Design SLI composition and formula for regional degradation score (SRE + Applied ML)
Instrument token-level p50/p95/p99/p999 and admit-rate per region with sequence-length bucketing
Build Grafana explorer panels and a dedicated 'Region Degradation' dashboard
Prototype lightweight orchestration controller (read-only by default behind FF) to propose threshold changes
Write runbook and add Playbook steps for on-call to follow during region degradation
Add synthetic traffic test harness and unit/integration tests for the controller
design_notes:
We define a regional degradation score as a weighted sum: 0.6*normalized(p99_latency_tok) + 0.25*(1 - admit_rate) + 0.15*(expected_kv_miss_increase). Weighting is negotiable; initial weights chosen to prioritize latency spikes. We will bucket by sequence-length (short: <64, medium: 64-512, long: >512) because tail contributions differ. Data points are sampled per 10s window and aggregated to 1m for dashboarding.

Trade-offs considered:
- Aggressive smoothing reduces noise but hides microbursts; we will surface both smoothed and raw signals.
- Controller will operate in proposal-only mode for first 2 cycles to gather human-reviewed telemetry.
- We avoid automatic cross-region traffic shift in this ticket to reduce blast radius; only threshold recommendations and manual apply are supported.
implementation_plan:
Phase 1 (2 sprints): SLI instrumentation + dashboard panels. Owner: Miguel.
Phase 2 (1 sprint): Controller prototype with a dry-run API and DB of proposals. Owner: Sasha.
Phase 3 (1 sprint): Runbook, synthetic tests, and internal canary (apply in staging + shadow mode). Owner: Miguel.

Key dev tasks:
- Add metrics to token-timing pipeline: publish p50/p95/p99/p999 histograms tagged by region/model/route/seq_bucket (ENG-581909-METRICS PR).
- Build Grafana panels with cross-filtering and annotation support for proposals.
- Controller: small Go service that reads metric sinks, calculates recommended thresholds, and stores proposals in postgres; proposals are surfaced in Grafana via annotations.

PRs and branches: see attachments.
rollout_plan:
Start internal staging canary for 48 hours, monitor degradation score vs existing SLOs.
Week 1: proposal-only mode, collect operator feedback.
Week 2: allow operator-apply via internal console and run a single-model, single-region small-scale test.
If no regressions after 1 week, expand to additional regions.
Rollback: revert controller FF and manually reset thresholds; runbook lists exact metric checkpoints for rollback conditions.
monitoring_and_dashboard:
New Grafana dashboard 'Regional Degradation Explorer' with sections: Overview (score by region), Route heatmap, Sequence-length cohort charts, Proposal timeline (annotations), and Correlation view (score vs failover count).
Dashboards link to existing token-latency SLO dashboards and to the Synthetic Traffic dashboard.
Alerts: create ephemeral alerting for internal canary only: degradation_score > 70 for 5m triggers Slack notify to #sre-region and opens incident-draft ticket.
Metrics endpoints: /metrics (Prometheus), proposal events to event-log (Kafka) with schema version v1.
qa_plan:
Unit tests for metric aggregation and score formula. Integration test that injects synthetic token-latency traces and verifies dashboard values. Runbook dry-run exercises with on-call to simulate region degradation and practice manual apply/rollback.
Load test controller under 1000 proposals/hour to validate performance.
